verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a documented Public APIv2 with an OpenAPI reference and OAuth setup guide. It covers broad CRUD operations across controls, policies and versions, evidence library, custom frameworks, monitoring tests, personnel, devices, custom connections, risks and audits, which is enough to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a raw OpenAPI spec discoverable at standard paths (probes returned 404 for openapi.json and llms.txt), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
